verdict.rationale: A training-data opt-out is a fair question for a cloud AI agent product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no statement about training-data use or an opt-out control. The cited approvals, security, and privacy items cover action approvals, credential handoff, and network egress, which are adjacent controls, not training opt-outs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
